nonTidalAreas.name: Lake Union & Ship Canal
nonTidalAreas.comment: Fresh water east of the Ballard Locks: Salmon Bay, the Ship Canal, Lake Union, Portage Bay, Montlake Cut, Union Bay. West edge is the locks.

nonTidalAreas.name: Lake Washington
nonTidalAreas.comment: West edge stays east of the Duwamish (tidal) in the south and of Puget Sound in the north.

routeNotes.name: Ballard Locks
routeNotes.message: This route goes through the Ballard Locks (Hiram M. Chittenden Locks). The wait to lock through often runs 30–60 minutes and isn't included in the estimate — add it as a stop at the nearest waypoint if you want it counted.
